data.name: The Team Seven
data.detailed_description:
Pre-Purchase Offer

The Team Seven Rewards People who Preorders The Game Now!
The Team Seven takes 5v5 tactical shooter gameplay to the next level by combining specialized agent abilities with dynamic, fully destructible environments. EXPLORE VARIOUS REWARDS BY SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT STAGE BY PREORDERING THE GAME NOW!


About the Game

The Team Seven is a 5v5 competitive hero-shooter set in the universe of Yedinci Takım. Master specialized agent abilities and breach fully destructible environments in intense tactical combat. Whether you are planting the charge in Bomb Defusal, clearing rooms in Hostage Rescue, or diving into the story-driven Campaign, every wall is a potential line of sight—and every round demands total precision.

Fully Destructible Environments: No wall is safe. Tear down cover, create custom sightlines, and rewrite the map layout to outsmart your enemies.

Tactical 5v5 Hero Action: Choose your agent, synergize unique abilities with your squad, and execute high-stakes strategies.

Diverse Game Modes: Compete in high-intensity Bomb Defusal with a 40-second prep phase, breach hot zones in Hostage Rescue, or experience the story in the narrative Campaign.

Community & Expanded Universe: Play custom community maps, explore upcoming DLCs, and step into the iconic universe of Yedinci Takım.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 veya AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) veya AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: -15GB of storage (approximately)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K veya AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12GB) veya AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
